6th Street Water Main Abandonment
bids.description: Truckee Meadows Water Authority (TMWA) is accepting sealed bids for all labor, materials, equipment, and incidentals required for the abandonment of 92 linear feet of 6-inch cast iron water main and removal of 14 linear feet of 6-inch transite water main within the project vicinity. Included is the installation of approximately 47 linear feet of new 6-inch restrained ductile iron pipe with vertical offsets, 24"x6" hot tap assembly (w/TMWA to perform the tap), fittings, and appurtenances. The project also includes surface restoration (temporary and permanent pavement patching) as a result of water main installation. All content viewed and/or downloaded is considered confidential information and shall be used by the Recipient solely for the purpose of evaluating and potentially submitting a bid for the Project, and not in any way detrimental to TMWA. Recipient shall not copy or otherwise reproduce any confidential information and may not distribute any information to any third-party that is not necessary for purposes of evaluating and submitting a bid for the Project. The Engineer's estimate is: $130,005 - $158,895 This Project is deemed a Horizontal Construction Project.
